originality.rationale: The 2026 focal Proposition 5.2 gives precisely the same operator and filling integral, but establishes only the leading spectral equivalence (its equation 56), with no second-order gap coefficient. Full relevant source sections and older radial Toeplitz primary sources were inspected. Neither a published implication nor an indexed same-object formula was found that settles the exact positive digamma coefficient for every fixed d, alpha, and p; conventional radial diagonalization is credited as an ingredient. An unindexed equivalent formulation remains a genuine residual risk.
residual_risks: An equivalent two-term expansion may appear under a different radial Toeplitz, beta moment or complex hyperbolic spectral formulation not retrievable by the performed searches.
The older Bauer–Herrera Yañez–Vasilevski paper was not available for complete text inspection; only its abstract could be compared, so no whole-document noncoverage is asserted.

The beta log-moment expansion and radial diagonalization are classical ingredients: originality is confined to the exact strictly positive spectral-versus-filling gap at all fixed exponents and parameters.

value.rationale: The exact coefficient quantifies the first unavoidable positive gap between the discrete Toeplitz spectral filling cost and the continuous hyperbolic-volume rearrangement in the natural fixed-parameter weighted complex-ball model. The source proves only first-order equivalence; this gives the sharp next scale N(log N)^(p-1) and a weight-sensitive gamma/digamma invariant for all d>=1 and p>0, including a fractional range whose published moment comparison is too coarse to resolve the gap. This is a motivated nontrivial asymptotic boundary, not a renamed constant or an arbitrary slice.
